newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end slightly down in slow session.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end slightly down in slow session.

text.p: Manila shares slipped in light trade on Thursday, reflecting continued subdued market sentiment, traders said.
"It's still consolidating and we are likely to remain this way up to early next week," said Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Securities Inc.
The main index dipped 7.81 points, or 0.26 percent, to 3,041.78.
Most of the gainers were speculative issues like Abacus Consolidated Resources and gaming firm Greater Asia Resources Corp.
"There's switching of funds towards speculative (issues) in the absence of news on the commercial-industrial sector," said Teresa Lee, assistant vice president at Lippo Securities.
Total value of shares traded was thin at 1.9 billion pesos. Losers beat gainers at 61 to 53 with the prices of 65 remaining unchanged.
Jonas Ferrer, research head at Pryce Securities Inc said the release of third quarter earnings might cheer up the market in the near term.
